XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ACCESSORIES | CAR RADIO | INACTIVE | WARNING | CODE | DISCONNECTED | BATTERY

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: accessories

  • Device: car radio

  • Fault: after disconnecting the battery, the car radio does not work, "CODE" requested

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: car radio locked

• Action: enter the radio unlock code

  • Procedure:
    (1) enter the digits of the unlock code using the radio buttons; after entering the fourth digit (if the code is correct), the radio should switch on
    (2) the message "RADIO BLOCKED WAIT" indicates that the code entered is incorrect; in this case, leave the radio on for a few hours until the "CODE" request reappears
    (3) the unlock code is supplied with the standard radio together with the car, but can be requested again through a dealership

  • Notes: - -
